prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the two pigment container from mobile robot platform to workbench.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: mobile robot platform
What the inspection checks: Check whether the pigment container is on mobile robot platform.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: The photo shows a white bench or fixture plate, roughly square, standing on a grey tiled floor that fills the upper half of the frame. The plate's top surface has molded features: two long parallel recessed channels at the left, two oval recessed pockets along the back edge, several small square raised pads with central holes (two near the middle-rear, one at right, one in the lower centre), and numerous small drilled holes scattered across the surface, including a row along the lower right edge.

Lying on its side in the centre of the plate is a small dark teal/green cylindrical object with a white tapered tip pointing left, resembling a capped syringe or dispensing tube. No liquid is visible.
observations: The mobile robot platform plate shows only a single small teal cylindrical object (syringe/dispensing tube) lying on its side, with empty recessed pockets and pads; the two expected pigment containers are not present.

args.observations: The mobile robot platform plate shows only a single small teal cylindrical object (syringe/dispensing tube) lying on its side, with empty recessed pockets and pads; the two expected pigment containers are not present.
